Everything a modern site needs

Responsive by default

Set styles per breakpoint. Tablet and mobile inherit from desktop until you override them.

Design tokens

Colors, spacing and type live in theme.json, so core blocks and other plugins share them.

No lock-in

Everything is saved as native WordPress blocks. Your content survives a plugin switch.

Fast frontend

Only the CSS your page uses is printed, deduplicated. Zero JavaScript for static layouts.

Hover & focus states

Style interactions per breakpoint without writing CSS.

AI-ready

A structured style model that agents can read and edit safely.
